transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

Well... I guess I'm just having a hard time keeping my mind on one thing lately. I work at a warehouse, and... it's just hard. Every time a beeper goes off, or a forklift backs up, or somebody drops a pallet... I just lose my place. Then I end up putting the wrong numbers into the inventory. It's... yeah. That's why I'm here.
Do you have unwanted memories of a very frightening or traumatic event that suddenly pop into your mind?
No, not really. I don't... I don't have anything like that.
When you were a child, did you often have trouble paying attention or staying focused?
Um... no, not that I remember. I didn't really have any problems like that back then. I just... did my schoolwork, I guess. It wasn't an issue.
Have you been feeling down or depressed lately?
No... not really. I mean, I'm frustrated with work, but I wouldn't say I feel depressed. Just... annoyed at myself, I guess.
Do you find yourself worrying a lot about everyday things?
No, not really. I just... handle things as they come, I guess. I don't spend a lot of time sitting around worrying.
Do you ever have sudden attacks of intense fear or discomfort that come on out of the blue?
No... I don't think so. I don't really get scared like that. Nothing out of the blue, anyway.
Do you ever hear things that other people don’t seem to hear?
No... I don't hear anything like that. Just the normal stuff.
Do you get unusually jumpy or startled by sudden noises?
No. I mean... no more than anyone else would, I guess. I don't really notice it.
Do you often feel physically tense or unable to relax?
No... not really. I mean, my muscles get sore from work sometimes, but... I don't have trouble relaxing or anything. Just normal tired.
